comparisons.name: top-light
comparisons.description: Top-left 200 x 98 pt of the window, Aqua: the magnifying glass, the field, the first category band and the selected top hit. The capture is over the desktop picture; the gradient behind the window stands in for it. Masked: the text, set in the fallback font off Apple platforms (query, completion, category, result) and the result's icon, which is Apple artwork.

comparisons.name: list-dark
comparisons.description: Top-left 300 x 250 pt of the window, Dark Aqua: the rim, the magnifying glass, the field, two category bands, the selected first result, plain results, the line between list and preview and the preview's own background. A window capture with nothing behind the window, so the material is its opaque base. Masked: the text, set in the fallback font off Apple platforms (query, completion, categories, results), the results' icons, which are Apple artwork, and the preview's text at the crop's edge.

comparisons.name: arrow-down-dark
comparisons.description: Down Arrow in the field moves the selection to the second result, Dark Aqua. The keyboard focus stays in the field, which shows its focus line under the text.

pixels.note: selected second result: --mac-color-sidebar-selection-emphasized (measured on the first result: #0971ea)
first result, no longer selected: the window's base (measured)
focus line under the field's text: --mac-focus-ring-color, #2ba8ff at 50%, over the window's base; the library's own, no capture shows it

comparisons.name: inactive-selection-dark
comparisons.description: The selection in a window that is not key, Dark Aqua: grey instead of the accent colour. Inferred; no capture shows it.

pixels.note: --mac-color-sidebar-selection, white at 17%, over the window's base #2b2c2d; inferred
a result that is not selected: the window's base (measured)
no focus line without the keyboard focus: the window's base
